profile.headline: computer systems engineer / architect
profile.summary:
goals:  Have fun, share, and mentor. Lead, design and implement platforms. Play in complex infrastructures.

See https://tony.wuersch.name/resume.txt for a resume.
Github repo:
https://github.com/awuersch/cb-lxc-dockerfiles

positions.title: DevOps Engineer w/data science background.
positions.description: Learning (Java8, OCaml, Travis CI/Github, Docker). Building a cloud infrastructure with single sign-on (Kerberos+TLS), high availability (HAProxy), and db-based apps (Postgres). Wrote an OCaml package for Openssl-style config files. Pursued a vision of privacy synced with locations, especially rooms in homes. Relearning data science, esp. Bayesian data analysis, at grad school level.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: PHP, MySQL, MSSQL, Python, R, C, Puppet, Bash, Unix. Backup for release management "deploy" app (PHP, Github, Jenkins). Wrote/maintained Wayfair’s logging API to ElasticSearch. Implemented auto-repair of PHP code sniffs by token surgery. Wrote a Python app forwarding job status from Jenkins to Zabbix, with automated reconfig. Setup URL shortening with yourls. Took over a legacy IT asset DB and UI (“Ship”). Refactored URL redirection to use PDO/MSSQL. Puppetized OpenGrok to Tomcat/Java 8.  Ported 100s of dashboards to Grafana. Cleaned up and censored sensitive logs.

positions.title: Systems Engineer, Portfolio Infrastructure
positions.description: C++ coder.  Lead maintainer of a mission-critical portfolio data query app used by all portfolio-related Bloomberg functions.

positions.title: Senior Technical Director
positions.description: Till 2000, technical lead for firewall rule design, implementation and deployment in NYSE production.  Till 2004, on SIAC"s data security review board.  Since 2000, designing and operating data warehouses and reporting frameworks for trading application and server performance metrics at NYSE and NYSE-ARCA.  Leads and initiates data-driven change.
